m.s: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan over high heat. Cook {beef_mince} for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until well browned. Add finely diced {onion} and cook for 5 minutes, then add crushed {garlic}, {cumin}, {smokedpaprika}, {chillipowder} and {oregano} and stir for 1 minute.
Stir in {tompaste}, then add {tintom} and {blackbeans}, drained and rinsed. Simmer for 10 minutes until thick, then season well. Heat the oven to 200°C.

Mash {avocado} with the juice of {lime*0.5}, a pinch of salt and some chopped {coriander}. For the salsa, chop {cherrytom} and finely dice {red_onion}, then toss with the rest of the lime, more coriander and a pinch of salt.
Spread {cornchips} over one or two large trays. Spoon over the beef and cover with {cheese}.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling and the chips are hot.
Top with the guac, salsa, {sourcream} and {jalapenos}, and get it on the table fast before the chips soften.

l: Pack the beef with rice instead of chips (burrito bowl style), toppings on the side. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: Plain corn chips are usually gluten free, but check the bag. Check the spices too.
